title: בן בוכרי
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Ben Bukhri testified at Yavneh; Zakkai addressed him, Shekalim 1; Menachot 46b, 21b; Arakhin 4a. Yuchasin under kaf quotes Arukh: a sieve-maker’s name. I did not find it: Arukh has ben Kovri, a person’s name. Heilprin says that all the passages cited above read Bukhri with bet.
